about: b1-u1's record says 'sea glass' but the note holds 'sea-glass'; b1-u2's copy was never written. Each copies line missing from its note, or different from the record, is copy-mismatch naming the record's note, with before empty and the record's copy text as after (spec-edit-guard.md 03.3 item 1; 05 item 4). The hyphenated line in the note matches no copies line, so it is unexplained-change with no unit. Both pointers name idea-tobias, as each record does, so no pointer-mismatch.
